title: fix(scripts): the polarity census splits the schema-absent bucket into the corpus boundary and the schema that is gone (objectui#9767)
body:
Fixes #9767

Clause-②: no — internal census script, no published export and no authoring surface; splitting one bucket into two named report lines is a REPORT-surface change that widens no accept set.

## What the bucket actually contained, measured here, at the ref it was measured at

⛔ The card's 93 / 2 / 5 split is PR objectui#9765's reading at its own ref and the card says so. I re-took it rather than carrying it.

- merge base: `6c3944c302` (`origin/main` at branch time; `origin/main` has since moved to `19d1f24bfb`, whose one commit touches neither the instrument nor the symbol below)
- branch head the reading was taken at: `415006c3aa`
- command: `node scripts/changeset-polarity-census.mjs --json`, controls PASS

The bucket is **62 rows across 35 distinct symbols**, and it partitions three ways, ⛔ not two:

| where the symbol resolves | rows | symbols |
| --- | --- | --- |
| declared dependency `@objectstack/spec@17.4.0` | 58 | 31 |
| this repo, outside the indexed tree (`packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.tsx`) | 1 | 1 |
| nowhere this run can reach | 3 | 3 |

The three with no reachable declaration, key by key: `BlockSchema` and `BlockInstanceSchema` (both in `block-schema-docs-truth-4895.md`, and both appear in this tree only inside the objectui#4895 retirement note and its pin), and `KanbanSchema` (in `7322-object-kanban-component-props.md`). ⚠️ Those three are CANDIDATES and nothing more — ROTTED and BORN FALSE take opposite repairs and BORN FALSE is only decidable at a sentence's write-time ref. ⛔ No changeset body is touched by this PR and this bucket is ⛔ not swept, per the card.

## ⭐ Where I deviated from the card's predicate, and why what I read wins

The card and two seats carry the estimate that the split criterion is "resolves in a declared dependency". The bucket's measured membership refuses it: `LineItemsPanelSchema` is declared in a SIBLING PACKAGE of this repo, outside the indexed `packages/types/src`. It is at the same corpus boundary as the 31 — the instrument simply does not index that tree — but the narrow predicate would have filed it on the "the schema is gone" line, **reproducing this card's own defect at one symbol instead of the 32 it currently mislabels**.

⇒ The split is decided on "does the symbol resolve in a root the indexed tree reaches past", and the roots are two: the declared dependencies of the package that OWNS the indexed tree (derived from its `package.json`, ⛔ never hand-listed) and this repo outside that tree. Each resolved row reports WHERE it resolved, so the three-way fact is readable off a two-line summary. The wider predicate is pinned, so it cannot be narrowed back silently.

## The split's own controls — because its failure mode is loud damage from a quiet cause

A resolution root that cannot be read declares nothing, every symbol living in it falls to the second line, and the report then claims a pile of live schemas are gone. So the controls are PER ROOT: every root the owning manifest declares must be readable AND yield declarations, or the run exits 2 and its numbers are void. And a run given no resolution index reports the split as `SPLIT NOT MEASURED` rather than as an empty gone-line — an empty line there would be a zero from a probe that never ran, reported as a measurement.

## The fourth precision source

Added to the instrument's own limits list, which objectui#9766 had already reopened with "add to it here when you find another". ⛔ I did not rewrite that section — the triage assigned its rewrite to objectui#9766, which has landed; this adds one entry beside the existing ones.

## Test — the pin asserts the substance, and it was ablated

`scripts/__tests__/changeset-polarity-census.test.ts` pin 11, on fixtures (a fixture declared-dependency `.d.ts` root and a fixture workspace root):

- a symbol declared in a declared dependency lands on the resolved line, with the root and the repo-relative site named, and is NOT on the other line
- a symbol declared in no root lands on the other line, and only there
- the repo-root leg — the deviation above — pinned on its own
- the two lines partition the bucket, with both halves asserted non-empty so the partition cannot be vacuous
- no resolution index reads as unmeasured, ⛔ not as "nothing is gone"
- an unreadable root voids the run, with the lit leg on the same instrument

**Ablation, at `415006c3aa`.** Mutation: the row's resolution lookup replaced by `null` — the pre-card behaviour, one undifferentiated bucket. Proven on disk before the run (anchor matched exactly once, 1 hit for the injected text and 0 for the deleted text after the write, HEAD blob `5c1931d0` vs worktree blob `f00ae7e9`), restored by an `EXIT INT TERM` trap pointed at `HEAD` and verified by an empty `git diff HEAD`.

```
before ablation:  Tests  57 passed (57)
under ablation:   Tests   3 failed | 54 passed (57)
  x a symbol declared in a DECLARED DEPENDENCY lands on the resolved line
  x the split is NOT "resolves in a declared dependency" alone -- the repo root is a root
  x the two lines PARTITION the bucket -- nothing is dropped and nothing is counted twice
```

⚠️ Reported because it is the honest half: the one test that only reads the two LINE LABELS off the report stays green under that mutation. That is exactly why it is not the pin — the substance pins above are.

## Verification

- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/` — `Test Files 173 passed | 2 skipped (175)`, `Tests 5125 passed | 2 skipped (5127)`
- `pnpm exec eslint` on every changed file — exit 0
- `check:control-bytes` · `check:unreferenced-sources` · `check:changeset-claims` · `check:pending-changeset-literals` · `check:new-line-citations` · `check:entry-guard` · `check:comment-mask-corpus` · `check:doc-example-readers` — all exit 0
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` — exit 0; the changeset is an empty-frontmatter "no release" declaration, since nothing under a published package's `files` moves
- repo-wide `pnpm lint` and `pnpm test` are CI's run, ⛔ not claimed here

⚠️ `scripts/__tests__/fixtures/changeset-polarity/workspace/` is a `.ts`, ⛔ not the `.tsx` the live repo-side symbol lives in: `tsconfig.scripts.json`'s program does not reach `.tsx` under `scripts/`, and `scripts-type-check.test.ts` correctly rejected the first spelling. The `.tsx` half of the root's extension list is asserted directly instead.

## Bounded transition

⭐ I split ONE bucket into TWO named lines and reported the site each row lands on. ⛔ I did not touch the polarity read, the key reader, the population predicate or any changeset body — the contradiction count is unchanged at this ref. ⚠️ **objectui#9754 slice 2 must re-take its sampling base after this lands**: the verdict table's row set changed shape, and the JSON gained `schemasOutsideIndex`, `schemasResolvingNowhere` and `resolutionRoots` (`unresolvedSchemas` is kept as the union, each row now carrying `resolvedIn`).

## Acceptance notes

Noted while reading, ⛔ not filed and ⛔ not acted on:

- `scripts/changeset-polarity-census.mjs`'s report prints "1 claims across 1 symbols" when a count is one. Cosmetic, and the file's other tables read the same way. Carrier: whoever next edits this report surface — objectui#9754 slice 2.
- `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` answers `false` in this container, while the card and the fence comment both state the checkout is shallow. Nothing in this PR depends on either answer — I judged no write-time ref — but the next card that budgets for a deepen should re-read it rather than inherit the claim.

## ⚠️ Appended by the dispatching `domain:spec` seat — the ablation block above is anchored to a SUPERSEDED head

Added at 2026-09-18T10:59Z by `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L`, at the implementer's explicit request: the dev contract writes a PR body once and ⛔ does not PATCH it, so the author could not correct this itself. ⛔ Nothing above has been altered — this block is additive, and the body's **measurement** section is unchanged and still correct.

**Head history.** This PR's first head `415006c3aa` was **RED on `Type Check`** (24 tsc errors locally, 5 surfaced by CI, all in this PR's own new pin file). The seat rejected the first delivery on that ground. The fix landed as a second push.

⇒ **Current head: `c034e48e7644f07474dc76fa9658391118eb3b2e`.**

**What the ablation block above does NOT cover.** It names `415006c3aa` and blobs `5c1931d0` / `f00ae7e9`. ⭐ That evidence is anchored to a tree that no longer exists and ⛔ does not carry forward. The ablation was **re-run at the new head**:

- HEAD blob `b4cd5e9417accf549c166c5d4bcdf6c3bcf7b09b` vs worktree blob `0965ce21b349de464524283338c5e6982bb325a5` (different ⇒ ⛔ not a no-op)
- mutation: the row's resolution lookup replaced by a constant `null` — the pre-card behaviour, one undifferentiated bucket
- result: **`Tests 3 failed | 54 passed (57)`** — the dependency-lands-on-the-resolved-line pin, the repo-root pin and the partition pin all red
- ⚠️ reported honestly by the implementer: the one test that reads only the two **line labels** off the report stays **GREEN** under that mutation. ⭐ That is precisely why it is not the pin, and why the three substance pins are.

**Verification the list above omits:** `VERDICT type-check:scripts exit=0` (was exit=2 / 24 errors at the old head) and `VERDICT type-check:coverage exit=0`.

**Why the first head's red was missed, recorded because the reasoning error outlives the bug.** The implementer ran `vitest` and `eslint` over `scripts/` but never `pnpm type-check:scripts`; `scripts-type-check.test.ts`, which it *did* run, checks **program coverage** and ⛔ not `tsc` errors, so it was green while `tsc` was red. ⇒ ⭐ A gate that is green because it measures something adjacent is worse than no gate, because it is read as one.

**And the fix is on the declared shape, ⛔ not a silencer** — verified independently by the seat over this PR's full diff: the only occurrence of `as any` in 34,952 bytes is inside a comment saying not to use them, with the probe's lit control confirming it can find the string at all. `TS2322` was the substantive error: a bare `resolutionIndex = null` **declared** the parameter as `null`, so every caller passing a real index was a type error and every read of the split buckets was "possibly null". The repair declares `ResolutionIndex` and widens the parameter to `ResolutionIndex | null`.
